title: FOUNDING DAY
style:
celebratory electronic pop warm synth bass building energy 108 bpm 44
  anthemic chorus zynthio frequency hopeful and powerful pharrell meets the
  weeknd meets Alternative Rock, Pop Rock, Post-Britpop, Britpop digital confetti drop at chorus birthday energy meets
  product launch multilingual warmth signal breaking through
lyrics:
[Intro]
  February twenty-fourth
  The day the signal went live
  Forty-eight years in the making
  Now watch everything arrive

  [Verse 1]
  CoreyAI — every time an AI breaks
  We write it down, we track the mistakes
  Search the database, find the pattern
  Nothing gets buried, nothing gets forgotten

  MOSOKO — sixty seconds of your voice
  Every language, every lesson, every choice
  Your sound crosses every border
  The whole world hears you in order

  KERVALON — one URL, thirty seconds flat
  Is the name available? We tell you that
  Trademark, domain, one click to check
  No more six-tab browser wreck

  PLUGGED — ninety seconds every morning
  Neo plugged in, no warning
  Download the skill, live the day
  That's the ZYNTHIO way

  [Pre-Chorus]
  Six products, one signal
  Six doors, one house
  Today they all open
  Today it all counts

  [Chorus]
  This is founding day
  This is where we start
  This is founding day
  The signal from the heart

  Free Pro for everyone
  February twenty-fourth
  Forty-eight on a Tuesday
  The whole world moves north

  This is founding day
  This is where it's real
  ZYNTHIO, CoreyAI
  Feel what you can feel

  [Verse 2]
  The Gold codes are in the hands
  Of people who believe in the plans
  Namborus, Shireen, David, José
  The pilot crew — they found the way

  336 — the master number
  3 minutes 36 — no wonder
  Every track lands right on time
  The signal finds its rhyme

  Birthday promo — February to the twenty-eighth
  Full Pro for free — no card, no wait
  Leave feedback after — keep the basic
  The deal is clean, nothing's chaotic

  [Chorus]
  This is founding day
  This is where we start
  This is founding day
  The signal from the heart

  Free Pro for everyone
  February twenty-fourth
  Forty-eight on a Tuesday
  The whole world moves north

  [Bridge]
  I built this in the dark
  Terminal open, city asleep
  Every product is a promise
  Every line of code is deep

  CoreyAI, MOSOKO, PLUGGED, KERVALON
  ENAMOUR, ZYNTHIO — we're on

  [Final Chorus]
  This is founding day
  This is where we start
  This is founding day
  The signal from the heart

  ZYNTHIO.
